name: rideo
description: All-in-one AI video generation and editing studio

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rideo/web && npm run build -w @rideo/server && npm run build -w @rideo/mock-gateway
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/mock-gateway && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --project shared --project server-unit --project web --project e2e-harness
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @rideo/web && npm run build:lib && npm run build:e2e-host && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:real: npm run build -w @rideo/web && playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --project shared --project server-unit --project web --project e2e-harness --coverage
